issues.description: Method calculateRemainingOrderNumber(): Problem statement (UML and textual requirements) specifies calculateRemainingOrderNumber() should return an int representing the number of remaining orders. The solution implementation declares calculateRemainingOrderNumber() as void and prints order numbers instead of returning an int. This mismatch between the expected return type and the solution's signature/behavior will confuse students about the required API and can cause tests or student implementations that expect an int return value to fail or not compile against the expected signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution's method signature to 'public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber()' and return the computed remaining orders (for example, return this.orders.length). If printing progress lines is desired for demonstration, keep printing as a side-effect but still return the integer. Also correct any off-by-one logic (do not add +1 to this.orders.length) so the returned value equals the actual number of remaining orders.
